messages:
erin: Heads-up — customer acme-inc reported that their org-level latency dashboard shows no p95/p99 series after the ingest proxy change this morning. They only see p50 and avg lines. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/latency.png :frowning:

jack: Ack. Can you paste the org id and a permalink to the dashboard? any query errors in console?

erin: Org: org_7342. Dashboard permalink: https://console.redwood/in/7342/d/latency. They say panels return zero for the percentile series; panel inspector shows the query returns series present for p50 but p95/p99 rows are blank. No JS console errors on their side.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T08:12:03Z -> service: telemetry-proxy v3.14.0 rolled to canary (10%) :rocket:

lucy: Hmm, we rolled a small telemetry-proxy change that collapsed tag sets with low cardinality into a single aggregate to reduce metric cardinality. Need to check if percentile buckets got deduped incorrectly. :thinking_face:

alec: Quick repro steps I ran in staging:
```
# query to backend metrics service
GET /metrics/query?org=org_7342&metric=latency_ms&quantiles=50,95,99&from=now-1h
```
staging response: p50/p95/p99 returned but p95/p99 had metric_id suffixes like "latency_ms;quantile=95;agg=hist" and our dashboard mapping expects the suffix "quantile=0.95". Looks like the proxy normalization changed the quantile label format.

jack: That would explain why panels only pick up p50 — it's still labeled 50 not 0.50 in the legacy selector. Can we patch the selector to accept both forms? Quick mitigation: add fallback matcher for both formats.

erin: Customer is impacted in prod. Can we do temporary rollback of the proxy canary? They have a customer call in 30m.

lucy: I can rollback the canary to 0% in 5m. Doing it now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: telemetry-proxy v3.13.8 -> canary scaled from 10% to 0% at 2026-03-17T08:34:10Z

jack: After rollback, metrics query returns previous label form. Can you confirm acme sees p95/p99 again?

erin: Customer confirms p95 and p99 series are back in their dashboard. They appreciated the fast response :thumbsup:.

alec: Follow-up action items: 1) Add compatibility parsing in the metrics ingestion layer to accept both quantile label variants, 2) Add unit tests for label normalization, 3) Update the rollout checklist to include percentile label compatibility test. I'll open a PR.

lucy: Filing a postmortem note and adding the canary rollback runbook entry.

jack: Thanks all. For the ticket: summary = "Quantile label format change in telemetry-proxy caused dashboard selectors to miss p95/p99; rolled back canary; compatibility patch + tests + rollout checklist to follow."

erin: I'll update the customer ticket and notify CS. Thread closed once PR is merged. :white_check_mark:
